brief:
Israeli settlers have besieged a Palestinian family's home on the outskirts of Qusra, south of Nablus, for more than 24 hours, Eye on Palestine reported. The settlers blocked access roads, trapping the family inside and preventing them from entering or leaving the residence.

The siege came as the homeowner sought ways to resolve the escalating standoff. Such encirclement tactics have become increasingly common in the West Bank, where Palestinian communities face repeated restrictions on movement and access to their properties by Israeli settler groups operating in the area.
